newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KFA buys 74,000 tonnes of Chinese corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KFA buys 74,000 tonnes of Chinese corn.

text.p: Korea Feed Association's (KFA) office in Pusan bought a total of 74,000 tonnes of Chinese corn on Saturday from Toepfer through private negotiation, traders said on Tuesday.
Traders said the purchase was made in three shipments.
The first delivery of 14,000 tonnes was made at $141.40 a tonne C&F for arrival by May 25 to the port of Pusan.
The second and the third, each for 30,000 tonnes, were made at $139.90 a tonne C&F for arrival by May 25 and by June 25 to the port of Ulsan.
Officials at the KFA's Pusan office were not immediately available for comment.
